studies.title: Einfach
studies.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production-quality 6-keyframe sword attack study for an existing child-friendly 2D game, NOT a new character design. Reference images define the character identity and body proportions. Keep the SAME cute stocky knight in ALL frames: large friendly head, silver-and-blue armor, blue helmet plume, red cape, thick armored upper arms, forearms, thighs and shins, chunky brown gloves and boots. Keep those proportions unchanged; never make the limbs thin or realistic adult proportions. The requested realism is in the BODY MECHANICS ONLY, never in the rendering style.
Exactly SIX full-body poses in a clean 3-column by 2-row atlas, chronological left-to-right in the top row then the bottom row. Each pose fits completely inside its own equally sized cell with at least 25 px transparent gutter. No text, no labels, no borders, no ground, no shadows or glow. Transparent background. All poses face RIGHT in the same three-quarter side view, same camera, consistent head size and ground baseline. One straight steel sword, visibly long blade (about 70% of knight's full height), ONE sword held ONLY in the knight's anatomical RIGHT hand; left arm holds a compact round shield. In the front-three-quarter starting stance, the sword arm is on viewer's LEFT, shield on viewer's RIGHT. The right arm moves OUTSIDE the torso silhouette, with an actual moving shoulder, upper arm and elbow driving the hand; wrist stays stable and aligned with the forearm. No wrist-only flick, no impossible elbows, no extra fingers or weapons. The sword remains attached to the same right glove in every pose, and blade length is constant. Make the movement readable at game size. Variant A, SIMPLE readable game slash. Six poses: 1 calm compact guard with sword diagonally upward on the outside; 2 small backswing led by shoulder, upper arm moves back; 3 shoulder and whole arm drive forward, elbow opens; 4 clear extended forward cut with sword diagonally down toward the opponent; 5 compact follow-through outside the front knee; 6 return to the first guard. Feet mostly stay planted, mild torso turn. A very easy-to-read single whole-arm slash with a small amount of body movement. No exaggerated spinning or lunging. Output 1536x1024 PNG with genuine alpha transparency.

Six poses: 1 compact protective high guard with left foot leading, right foot behind; 2 clearly load the rear right leg, hips and chest coil, right upper arm opens back at shoulder while elbow stays naturally bent; 3 right foot begins a short passing step, pelvis leads, torso and shoulder follow, sword accelerates as elbow opens; 4 right foot lands forward exactly as the whole arm extends into a decisive diagonal cut, wrist straight, head stays balanced over body, left shield protects the opposite side; 5 decelerate the sword with whole shoulder and torso rotation, soft front knee, no locked or collapsed elbow, blade finishes low OUTSIDE the leg; 6 controlled recovery to guard without twisting the wrist alone. oasis: Edit the provided 960x600 game background. Preserve the same bright, warm painted cartoon style, sand textures, slightly elevated top-down game perspective, and large OPEN sandy playing area. Make it clearly a DESERT OASIS. Put a compact turquoise oasis pool ONLY in the UPPER RIGHT corner, approximately x=735..955 and y=20..165 in a 960x600 coordinate system. Shoreline is framed by chunky tan rocks, lush green date palms, reeds, small tropical leaves and a sandy lip. The pool must look like real visible water with gentle bright ripples. Keep ALL of the center and lower 70% dry sand and visually uncluttered, and keep the existing little rocks and green bushes around the lower and left edges. Leave the bottom-right open sandy edge clear of a large tree. This is a playable background: no characters, no chests, no interface, no text, no paths or decorative symbols. Do not add a horizon or switch to a side-on perspective. Canvas 960x600, full opaque background.
